item.title: Hero MotoCorp Q2FY27 results: Net profit soars 42% to ₹1,861 crore
item.description: India's largest two-wheeler maker Hero MotoCorp on Wednesday reported a 42 per cent year-on-year rise in consolidated profit after tax for the second quarter of the current fiscal. The company's consolidated profit for the quarter came in at Rs 1,861 crore, against Rs 1,308 crore in the year-ago period, according to a regulatory filing. Revenue from operations increased to Rs 14,971 crore, up 23 per cent from Rs 12,218 crore a year ago. "Results for the quarter and half-year include a Rs 397 crore gain from the equity consolidation of an associate company, following its capital raise via a Qualified Institutional Placement and Private Placement," the company said. Revenue was largely driven by volumes. Hero MotoCorp dispatched a total of 18.68 lakh motorcycles and scooters, registering a 10 per cent growth year-on-year. item.title: Jio IPO windfall brings mega party, early salaries, and bonus bonanza
item.description: Asia's richest man, Mukesh Ambani, is known for throwing lavish weddings for his children. On Wednesday, he brought that trademark scale of celebration to a corporate milestone, hosting a mega party for thousands of employees at Reliance Corporate Park to mark the blockbuster stock market debut of Jio Platforms Ltd. The celebrations extended beyond the party: October salaries have been paid early on October 15, and 75 per cent of employees' annual cash bonus or performance-linked incentive for the 2026-27 fiscal year was disbursed on Wednesday, months ahead of the usual post-financial-year payout. Thousands of employees and their families gathered at Reliance Corporate Park in the afternoon to celebrate the listing of the digital and telecommunications business, which raised a record Rs 30,213 crore in its initial public offering and thereafter saw a bumper listing on Wednesday.
